intro: CAVA Falafel is a popular plant-based protein option featured on the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains). These crispy, golden-brown chickpea and herb balls deliver authentic Mediterranean flavor with 350 calories per serving. As a base option on the [full CAVA menu](/), falafel provides a satisfying vegetarian alternative that complements any bowl or pita creation.
priceCalories: Falafel is available at base price ($0 additional cost) and contains 350 calories per serving. With 6g of protein, 24g of carbs, and 26g of fat, this main protein option offers balanced nutrition. Compared to other proteins on the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains), falafel provides excellent value as a flavorful, filling choice without extra charges.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets CAVA Falafel apart is its perfect blend of herbs and spices combined with quality chickpeas, fried to achieve an ideal crispy exterior and tender interior. Unlike mass-produced versions, these falafel balls maintain authentic Mediterranean taste while fitting seamlessly into customizable bowls and pitas available throughout the [full CAVA menu](/). The recipe balances traditional preparation with modern dietary preferences.
nutritionFacts: Each serving of CAVA Falafel provides 350 calories with 6g protein, 24g carbohydrates, and 26g fat. While higher in fat due to the frying process, falafel offers plant-based nutrition with fiber from chickpeas. Use the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) to track how falafel fits into your complete meal alongside bases, toppings, and dressings for accurate nutritional planning.
whatsInside: CAVA Falafel consists of fried chickpea and herb balls made from ground chickpeas blended with fresh herbs, spices, and aromatic ingredients. The mixture is formed into balls and fried until golden, creating a crunchy exterior that protects the moist, flavorful interior. This simple ingredient list makes falafel naturally vegan and suitable for various dietary preferences on the [CAVA Allergen Menu](/allergen-menu).
tasteLike: CAVA Falafel delivers earthy, savory flavors with herbal notes and a satisfying crunch. The exterior provides a crispy, golden texture while the inside remains soft and flavorful with hints of cumin, garlic, and fresh herbs. The chickpea base offers a mild, nutty taste that pairs perfectly with tangy dressings from the [CAVA Dressings Menu](/menu/dressings) and creamy options from [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads).
customize: Customize your falafel bowl by starting with grains or greens from the [CAVA Bases Menu](/menu/bases), then adding your choice of fresh vegetables and vibrant options from the [CAVA Toppings Menu](/menu/toppings). Enhance flavors with hummus, tzatziki, or harissa from [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads). Add tahini or lemon herb dressing to complement the falafel perfectly for a personalized Mediterranean experience.
pairsWell: Falafel pairs excellently with traditional Mediterranean accompaniments like hummus, tzatziki, and tahini dressing. It combines wonderfully with fresh tomatoes, cucumbers, pickled onions, and cabbage from the toppings selection. For a complete meal, add sides like pita chips or roasted vegetables. The crispy texture contrasts beautifully with creamy dips and crunchy fresh vegetables for balanced flavor profiles.
healthyChoice: As a plant-based protein, CAVA Falafel provides fiber-rich chickpeas that support digestive health and sustained energy. While the 26g of fat reflects the frying preparation, falafel remains a vegetarian-friendly option rich in complex carbohydrates. Check the [CAVA Gluten Free Menu](/gluten-free) if you have dietary restrictions, and balance your bowl with fresh vegetables to create a nutrient-dense meal under 600 calories.
howToOrder: Order falafel at any [CAVA Locations](/locations) by selecting it as your main protein when building a custom bowl or pita. Start by choosing your base, add falafel as your protein at no extra charge, then select three dips and spreads plus unlimited toppings. You can also enjoy falafel in signature creations from the [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls) or [CAVA Curated Pitas Menu](/menu/curated-pitas).
vsAlternatives: Compared to Grilled Chicken (250 cal) and Harissa Honey Chicken (260 cal), falafel offers 100 more calories but provides plant-based protein. While Grilled Steak (170 cal) and Braised Lamb (210 cal) cost $2.50-$3.25 extra, falafel comes at base price. Falafel contains higher fat (26g) than chicken options but delivers authentic Mediterranean flavor with vegetarian-friendly ingredients ideal for various dietary preferences.
whoShouldTry: CAVA Falafel is perfect for vegetarians, vegans, and anyone seeking plant-based protein options. Mediterranean food enthusiasts who appreciate authentic flavors will love the herbal, earthy taste. Budget-conscious diners benefit from the base pricing, while health-focused customers appreciate the chickpea-based nutrition. First-time CAVA visitors should try falafel to experience traditional Mediterranean cuisine in a customizable, modern format.
worthTrying: CAVA Falafel is absolutely worth trying for its authentic Mediterranean flavor, crispy texture, and excellent value at base price. The combination of herbs and chickpeas creates a satisfying, flavorful protein that works in countless combinations. Whether you follow a plant-based diet or simply enjoy diverse flavors, falafel offers a delicious way to experience CAVA culinary expertise without additional cost.

faqs.q: How many calories are in CAVA Falafel?
faqs.a: CAVA Falafel contains 350 calories per serving with 6g protein, 24g carbohydrates, and 26g fat. This makes it a moderately caloric protein option suitable for most dietary plans when balanced with fresh vegetables and lighter dressings.

faqs.q: Is CAVA Falafel vegan and gluten-free?
faqs.a: CAVA Falafel is vegan-friendly as it contains only chickpeas and herbs. However, check the CAVA Allergen Menu for gluten information as falafel may contain wheat flour or be prepared in shared fryers with gluten-containing items.

faqs.q: Does falafel cost extra at CAVA?
faqs.a: No, falafel is available at base price with no additional charge. This makes it an economical choice compared to premium proteins like Grilled Steak or Braised Lamb which cost $2.50-$3.25 extra per serving.

faqs.q: What does CAVA Falafel taste like?
faqs.a: CAVA Falafel has an earthy, savory flavor with herbal notes from fresh herbs and spices. The exterior is crispy and golden while the inside remains moist and tender with hints of cumin, garlic, and nutty chickpea flavor.

faqs.q: How should I customize my falafel bowl at CAVA?
faqs.a: Start with a grain or green base, add falafel as your protein, choose hummus or tzatziki as dips, then load up on fresh toppings like tomatoes, cucumbers, and pickled onions. Finish with tahini or lemon herb dressing for authentic Mediterranean flavor.
